data.creative: Rescue-foster secret: tried-everything pee story to plug-in · 1429057141452291
data.hook: I was cleaning pee every single day, until I found what rescue shelters used to stop indoor peeing.
data.desire: A home that does not smell of pee and a dog who stops going inside
data.angle: Everything tried has failed; a woman who fosters 15 dogs has a clean, odor-free house, and her secret is a plug-in
data.belief_shift: from indoor peeing is a training or cleaning problem → to it is a stress problem that a pheromone plug-in removes (advertiser claim)
data.script_structure: Daily-pee hook with shelter tease → list of failed fixes with dollar costs → acceptance → foster-lady discovery → mechanism (stress, pheromones) → 3-room setup and 48-hour result → savings + scarcity + 50% off → customer quote + millions of dog parents → 30-day pee-free guarantee
data.mechanism_reveal: Claim: dogs pee inside because of stress; the diffuser sends out dog pheromones that say 'this place is safe, no need to mark', working 24/7
data.proof: Failed-solution cost stack (0:06-0:27); foster-lady authority story (0:31-0:40); 48-hour and three-month result claims; customer quote card (1:22); review-wall collage with '249,558+' and 'Incredible results! - Alex M.' (1:25); sold-out-twice and millions of dog parents claims; 30-day money-back guarantee
data.cta: Get a pee-free home in 30 days or get your money back, guaranteed. Right now 50% off.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The cost stack makes the viewer tally her own wasted spending before the product appears, so the price later feels small. The foster-lady scene borrows authority from someone with far more dogs and no smell, which makes the cause (stress) feel discovered rather than sold.
data.transferable_move: Stack every failed fix with its dollar cost, then reveal the solution through an observer who handles the problem at a much larger scale with no trace of it. Do not copy unverified review counts or sold-out claims.
data.opening_visual: Wet puddle shining on a hardwood floor by a doorway, caption 'I was cleaning pee every single day until I found what rescue shelters used to stop indoor peeing'
data.transition_to_product: 0:38.6 'She showed me these little plugins' while a hand holds the TheraPetMD Calming Diffuser Kit box
data.proof_placement: Cost stack follows the hook; foster authority follows the acceptance beat; result claims follow the mechanism; review collage and guarantee follow the offer
